notes.title: New update for VEGAS Movie Studio 17 Platinum Steam Edition
notes.content:
[h1]Important changes in version 17.0.0.223 compared to version 17.0.0.204[/h1]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed errors which occur when reading some media due to a conflict with a recent Windows 10 update
[*]Crash on exit has been resolved
[*]Application will now properly detect hardware decoding devices
[*]Fixed support for MPEG-2 files with AC-3 audio
[*]Crash when drawing event handles has been resolved
[*]Fixed a crash which could occur when launching the RenderAs dialog
[*]Application no longer freezes or crashes when editing a credit roll
[*]Fixed issue where proxy files were unable to be generated
[/list]

notes.title: New update for VEGAS Movie Studio 17 Platinum Steam Edition
notes.content:
[h1]Important changes in version 17.0.0.204 compared to version 17.0.0.179[/h1]

[h2]Bug Fixes in this update[/h2]
[list]
[*] Brackground transparency is now working for the Picture-in-picture plugin on all AMD GPUs
[*] Fixed crash on startup when initializing the File I/O Manager
[*] MP4 option in the Make Movie dialog now encodes with proper bit rate
[*] Black Bar Fill plugin correctly blurs the background when expanded
[*] Channel Blend plugin now has consistent output with previous version of the application
[/list]

notes.title: New update for VEGAS Movie Studio 17 Platinum Steam Edition
notes.content:
[h1]Important changes in version 17.0.0.179 compared to version 17.0.0.143[/h1]

[list]
      [*] Generated Media window will now show proper presets in all cases
      [*]  Test Pattern media generator now generates frames properly
      [*]  Fixed problem where some media was being read by incorrect plugin
      [*] Names in the Generated Media window was display properly
      [*] All preset names in the plugin windows are no longer clipped
      [*] Proper default setting for Color Curves plugin is now set
      [*] Freeze Mode in the Video Stabilization plugin no longer results in black frames
      [*] Playing back an event with Video Stabilization applied will no longer hang on new AMD GPUs
      [*] Added floating window in the Welcome Screen to display project names which have been cut off
      [*] Clicking the Preview button in the Color Match plugin will no longer crash if the Preview Window is closed
      [*] Thumbnails for some iPhone files are now properly rotated at all times
      [*] Docking instructions for floating windows are more clearly displayed
      [*] Fixed a crash that may occur when adding some .mp4 files to a project
      [*] Fixed issue when the Third Party tab is being displayed in the plugin windows when it should not be there
      [*] Animations in the plugin windows now work correctly
      [*] Movie Studio now recognizes new versions of the SOUND FORGE products
[/list]
